caption: The drawing features three renderings of a soft shoe or moccasin on a plain background. Two of the renderings are outlined sketches in black, presenting top and slightly angled views of the shoe, showing a tied bow on the front. The third rendering is a colored drawing of the shoe, shown in profile, and is filled in with a light brown shade to represent a leather material. The shoe has a lace-up closure on the top, with visible crisscrossed laces and a tied bow. The background is off-white, and the artist's signature "M. CONCHA." is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Child's Shoe
